props.name: text
props.description: The words to set around the ring. Read once, as written, by assistive tech.

props.name: repeat
props.description: How many times the text goes around. Repeats are decoration and are not read out.

props.name: separator
props.description: Drawn between repeats, and after the last one so the join is invisible.

props.name: rotate
props.description: Turn slowly. Pauses while hovered or focused, and never runs under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: Centre slot — an icon, a logo, or a round button. Stays upright while the ring turns.
